**PERSEFONI PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT**
By executing an Order Form that references or incorporates this Agreement (including acceptance by click-through or similar electronic means), Customer accepts this Professional Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) with Persefoni AI Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its Affiliates (collectively, “Persefoni”) and agrees to be bound by its terms. Persefoni AI Inc. and the Customer are sometimes referred to individually as a “Party” and together as the “Parties.” The “Effective Date” is the date the first Order Form referencing this Agreement becomes effective.
This Agreement must be read with the applicable Order Form(s), whose terms control in the event of a conflict between this Agreement and the Order Form. Each Order Form is incorporated by reference into, and forms part of this Agreement.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants, terms, and conditions set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:
**1. Professional Services; Scope & Deliverables**
1.1 Scope of Services. Persefoni AI Inc. will provide, and Customer will cooperate in the receipt of, the Professional Services described in each applicable Order Form (each, an “Engagement”).
1.1.1 Deliverable Acceptance. Unless Customer notifies Persefoni in writing of any non-conformity of the Deliverable with the specifications in the Order Form within fifteen (15) Business Days after Persefoni’s delivery of such Deliverable, the Deliverable will be deemed accepted. If Customer timely notifies Persefoni of any non-conformity, Persefoni will use commercially reasonable efforts to cure the non-conformity within fifteen (15) Business Days, whereupon the Deliverable will be resubmitted for acceptance.
1.1.2 Change Orders. Any changes to the scope, schedule, Deliverables or Fees under an Order Form must be documented in a mutually executed Change Order. Neither Party shall unreasonably withhold or delay agreement to a Change Order requested by the other Party.
1.1.3 Customer Responsibilities. Customer will (a) reasonably and timely provide all Customer Materials, resources, information, personnel, and access required for Persefoni to perform the Professional Services; (b) ensure that all information provided is accurate and complete; and (c) designate a primary contact with authority to make decisions on Customer’s behalf. Persefoni is excused from any delay or failure to perform Professional Services to the extent resulting from Customer’s breach of this Section 1.1.3, provided Persefoni promptly notifies Customer of the issue.
**2. Persefoni Intellectual Property.**
Subject to the limited rights expressly granted hereunder, Persefoni and its licensors reserve all rights, title and interest in and to the Persefoni IP and all related Intellectual Property Rights. Persefoni grants to Customer a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Deliverables internally in connection with Customer’s business operations, subject to payment of all Fees.
**3. Fees and Payment**
3.1 Fees. Customer will pay Persefoni the fees set forth in the relevant Order Form in accordance with the terms therein (“Fees”), subject to any rights Customer may have under applicable law or Section 3.2 (Payments). Fees for time-and-materials engagements are estimates only unless expressly stated as fixed in the Order Form.
3.2 Payments. Persefoni will invoice Customer in accordance with the schedule in the Order Form; if no schedule is specified, Persefoni may invoice monthly in arrears. Payments are due net thirty (30) days from the invoice date and must be made in the currency identified on the applicable Order Form by a method mutually agreed by the Parties. All payments are non-cancellable and non-refundable except as expressly provided herein. If Customer fails to make any undisputed payment when due, late charges will accrue on non-disputed invoices at the rate of 1.5% per month or, if lower, the highest rate permitted by applicable law, and Persefoni may, after giving ten (10) Business Days’ written notice and opportunity to cure, suspend Professional Services until all undisputed amounts are paid. Customer may withhold payment of amounts it reasonably and in good faith disputes, provided it pays all undisputed amounts and states the basis of the dispute in writing within the payment period. Customer will reimburse Persefoni for all pre-approved expenses.
3.3 Taxes. Customer is responsible for all applicable sales, use, value-added, ad valorem and excise taxes, and any other similar taxes, duties and charges of any kind imposed by any governmental authority on any amount payable by Customer to Persefoni hereunder, other than any taxes imposed on Persefoni’s income. Without limiting the foregoing, if Customer is required to deduct or withhold any taxes from the amounts payable to Persefoni hereunder, Customer will pay an additional amount so that Persefoni receives the amounts due to it hereunder in full, as if there were no withholding or deduction.
3.4 Purchase Orders. If Customer requires a purchase order number to be included on Persefoni invoices and does not provide such number before the Order Form is executed, the omission of the purchase order number on a Persefoni invoice will not constitute a valid reason for delayed payment. Persefoni will reference any purchase order number provided by Customer prior to invoicing. Purchase order numbers can be sent to 
**4. Confidentiality**
4.1 Definition. As used herein, “Confidential Information” means any information that one Party (the “Disclosing Party”) provides to the other Party (the “Receiving Party”) in connection with this Agreement, whether orally or in writing, that is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be considered confidential given the nature of the information and/or the circumstances of disclosure. For clarity, the Persefoni IP will be deemed Confidential Information of Persefoni and Customer Materials will be deemed Confidential Information of Customer.
4.2 Obligations. The Receiving Party will maintain the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information in strict confidence and will not use the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party except as necessary to perform its obligations or exercise its rights under this Agreement. The Receiving Party will not disclose or cause to be disclosed any Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party except (i) to those employees, representatives or contractors of the Receiving Party who have a bona fide need to know such Confidential Information to perform under this Agreement and who are bound by written agreements with use and nondisclosure restrictions at least as protective as those set forth in this Agreement, or (ii) as such disclosure may be required by the order or requirement of a court, administrative agency or other governmental authority, subject to the Receiving Party providing to the Disclosing Party reasonable written notice, except where legally prohibited from providing such notice, to allow the Disclosing Party to seek a protective order or otherwise contest the disclosure.
4.3 Duration. Each Party's obligations of non-disclosure with respect to Confidential Information will commence on the Effective Date and will survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years thereafter.
4.4 Permitted Disclosure. The terms and conditions of this Agreement constitute Confidential Information of each Party but may be disclosed on a confidential basis to a Party’s advisors, attorneys, actual or bona fide potential acquirers, investors or other sources of funding (and their respective advisors and attorneys) for due diligence purposes.
4.5 Equitable Relief. Each Party agrees that a breach or threatened breach by such Party of any of its obligations under this Section 4 or any material misuse of Persefoni IP may cause the other Party irreparable harm and damages for which there may be no adequate remedy at law and that, in the event of such breach or threatened breach, the other Party will have the right to seek immediate equitable relief, including a restraining order, an injunction or specific performance, in addition to all other remedies available at law or in equity.
**5. Customer Materials**
5.1 License. Customer owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to all Customer Materials. Customer grants Persefoni a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right and license to use, host, reproduce, copy, transmit, sub-license, index, store, display and modify the Customer Materials (i) to the extent necessary to perform its obligations or enforce its rights under this Agreement; and (ii) solely where required or authorized by law.
5.2 Representations and Warranties. Customer represents and warrants that (i) it has obtained and will obtain and continue to have, during the Term, all necessary rights, authority and licenses for the access to and use of the Customer Materials as contemplated by this Agreement, and (ii) Persefoni’s use of the Customer Materials in accordance with this Agreement will not violate any applicable laws or regulations or cause a breach of any agreement or obligations between Customer and any third party. Customer will promptly notify Persefoni upon becoming aware of any violation of the foregoing warranty.
**6. Representations, Warranties and Disclaimer**
6.1 Authority. Each Party has the power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement. The individual signing the Order Form or otherwise accepting this Agreement is duly authorized to bind the applicable Party. This Agreement constitutes that Party’s binding obligation, enforceable against it in accordance with its terms, subject to bankruptcy and equity principles.
6.2 Performance Warranty. Persefoni warrants that the Professional Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for **thirty (30) days** after completion. Customer’s exclusive remedy for any breach of this warranty will be, at Persefoni’s option, re-performance or a pro-rata refund of the Fees paid for the non-conforming portion of Professional Services.
6.3 Disclaimer.**Except for the express warranties set out in Sections 6.1 and 6.2, the Professional Services, any Deliverables, and the Persefoni IP are provided “as is,” without any other warranties, including implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose or non-infringement. Persefoni does not warrant that the Professional Services will be error-free or uninterrupted, or that all defects will be corrected, and Persefoni is not responsible for issues caused by Customer Materials or third-party services.**
**7. Indemnification**
7.1 Persefoni Indemnification. Subject to Sections 7.3 and 7.4, Persefoni will defend Customer against any claim, suit or proceeding brought by a third party (“**Claim** ”) alleging that the Professional Services or any Deliverable provided under an Order Form infringes or misappropriates such third party’s Intellectual Property Rights and will indemnify Customer for any damages and costs finally awarded against Customer (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) resulting from such Claim.
7.2 Exclusions. Persefoni’s obligations under Section 7.1 will not apply if the underlying third-party Claim arises from or as a result of: (i) Customer’s breach of this Agreement, negligence, willful misconduct or fraud; (ii) any Customer Materials; (iii) Customer’s failure to implement any modifications or updates to a Deliverable that Persefoni offers to avoid infringement; (iv) modifications to a Deliverable by anyone other than Persefoni; or (v) combinations of a Deliverable with software, data or materials not provided by Persefoni.
7.3 Infringement Remedies. If Persefoni reasonably believes a Deliverable or the Professional Services could infringe any third party’s Intellectual Property Rights, Persefoni may, at its sole option and expense, use commercially reasonable efforts to: (i) modify or replace the Deliverable or Professional Services to make them non-infringing; or (ii) procure the right for Customer to continue use. If Persefoni determines that neither alternative is commercially practicable, Persefoni may terminate the affected Order Form or, if applicable, this Agreement by providing written notice to Customer and will refund any pre-paid professional services fees for the infringing portion not yet rendered. The rights and remedies set forth in Section 7.3 constitute Customer’s sole and exclusive remedy for any infringement or misappropriation of Intellectual Property Rights in connection with the Professional Services.
7.4 Customer Indemnification. Subject to Section 7.5, Customer will defend Persefoni against Claims arising from (i) any Customer Materials, including, without limitation, (A) any Claim that the Customer Materials infringe, misappropriate or otherwise violate any third party’s Intellectual Property Rights or privacy or other rights; or (B) any Claim that the use, provision, transmission, display or storage of Customer Materials violates any applicable law, rule or regulation; (ii) any of Customer’s products or services; and (iii) Persefoni’s misuse of any Deliverable or Customer’s breach of this Agreement, and in each case will indemnify and hold harmless Persefoni against any damages and costs awarded against Persefoni or agreed in settlement by Customer (including reasonable attorneys’ fees) resulting from such Claim.
7.5 Procedures. The Party seeking defense and indemnity (the “Indemnified Party”) will promptly notify the other Party (the “Indemnifying Party”) of any Claim for which indemnity is sought and will reasonably cooperate with the Indemnifying Party in the defense and/or settlement thereof. The Indemnifying Party will have the sole right to conduct the defense of any Claim for which it is responsible hereunder (_provided_ that the Indemnifying Party may not settle any Claim without the Indemnified Party's prior written approval unless the settlement is for a monetary amount, unconditionally releases the Indemnified Party from all liability without prejudice, does not require any admission by the Indemnified Party, and does not place restrictions upon the Indemnified Party's business, products or services). The Indemnified Party may participate in the defense or settlement of any such Claim at its own expense and with its own choice of counsel or, if the Indemnifying Party fails to fulfil its obligation of defense, the Indemnified Party may defend itself and seek reimbursement from the Indemnifying Party.
**8. Limitations of Liability**
8.1 Exclusion of Certain Damages. Except for (i) any infringement by one Party of the other Party’s Intellectual Property Rights, (ii) fraud or willful misconduct by either Party, or (iii) breach of Customer’s payment obligations, neither Party will be liable to the other for any incidental, special, exemplary, punitive or consequential damages, or any loss of income, sales, data, profits, revenue, business interruption, goodwill, reputation, or the cost of substitute services or other economic loss, arising out of or in connection with this Agreement or the Professional Services, whether such liability arises from any claim based on contract, warranty, tort (including negligence), strict liability or otherwise, and whether or not such Party was advised of the possibility of such loss or damage.
8.2 Aggregate Liability Cap. In no event will either Party’s total liability to the other in connection with this Agreement exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer to Persefoni in the twelve (12) month period preceding the event giving rise to the claim, regardless of the legal or equitable theory on which the claim or liability is based, and whether or not a Party was advised of the possibility of such loss or damage. The foregoing limitations will not limit Customer’s right to recover amounts expressly refundable under this Agreement.
**9. Term and Termination**
9.1 Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until the last date specified in any Order Form (the “Term”), unless earlier terminated as provided herein.
9.2 Termination for Convenience. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days’ prior written notice to Persefoni. In such event, Persefoni will refund any pre-paid Fees for Professional Services not yet performed as of the termination effective date.
9.3 Survival. The following Sections survive any termination or expiration of this Agreement: Definitions (as applicable), Fees and Payment, Confidential Information, Intellectual Property, Ownership of Persefoni IP, Representations, Warranties & Disclaimer, Indemnification, Limitations of Liability, Term and Termination, Effect of Termination, Promotion, and General.
9.4 Effect of Termination. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement: (i) all ongoing Professional Services will cease immediately; and (ii) each Party will promptly return or, at the Disclosing Party’s written election, destroy all Confidential Information in its possession or control. Upon Customer’s written request made within thirty (30) days after termination, Persefoni will deliver to Customer one (1) copy of all Customer Materials in Persefoni’s possession in a commercially reasonable format. No expiration or termination will affect Customer’s obligation to pay all Fees that may have become due or accrued through the effective date of expiration or termination or entitle Customer to any refund, except as expressly provided herein.
**10. General Terms**
10.1 Entire Agreement. Notices to Customer may be indicated on the applicable Order Form.

10.4 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by New York law (without regard to conflict-of-laws principles), and the Parties consent to exclusive jurisdiction and venue in the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.
10.5 Assignment. Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party’s written consent, except to a successor to substantially all of its business or assets. Any attempted assignment in violation of this Section 10.5 will be null and void.
10.6 Insurance. During the Term and for one (1) year thereafter, Persefoni will maintain commercially reasonable insurance customary for SaaS and professional services providers, including: workers’ compensation (as required by law); employer’s liability (not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence); commercial general liability (not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence/US$2,000,000 aggregate); technology errors and omissions/cyber insurance (not less than US$2,000,000 per claim); and automobile liability where applicable. Persefoni will provide certificates of insurance upon Customer’s reasonable request, without naming Customer as an additional insured.
10.7 Security. Persefoni will maintain commercially reasonable administrative, physical and technical safeguards to protect Customer Materials under its control and, upon becoming aware of any unauthorized access to such Customer Materials (a “Security Incident”), will promptly notify Customer, including the categories and approximate volume of affected data, investigate, and take reasonable steps to mitigate and prevent recurrence.
10.8 Non-Solicitation. During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party will knowingly solicit for employment or engagement any employee or contractor of the other materially involved in the Professional Services, except for general solicitations not directed at such individuals and hires resulting from responses thereto.
10.9 Force Majeure. Neither Party is liable for delay or failure (other than payment obligations) caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including labor disputes, internet or telecom failures, cyberattacks, epidemics, governmental actions or acts of God, provided that the affected Party promptly notifies the other Party and uses commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate the effects.
10.10 Subcontractors; Compliance; Independent Contractors. Persefoni may use subcontractors and remain liable for their acts and omissions as if they were their own. Each Party will comply with all applicable laws, including export controls. The Parties are independent contractors; this Agreement creates no partnership, joint venture or agency, and neither Party may bind the other. There are no third-party beneficiaries to this Agreement.
10.11 Location. Professional Services are provided remotely. Persefoni has no need to enter Customer’s physical location to provide the services.
10.12 Counterparts; Signatures. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signatures, each of which will be deemed an original and all of which together constitute one and the same instrument.

グローバルSMSおよびメッセージング同意ポリシー  
  

本グローバルSMSおよびメッセージング同意ポリシー（以下「本ポリシー」）は、Persefoni AI Inc.（以下「Persefoni」、「当社」）によるSMS、MMS、対話型メッセージング、および第三者メッセージングプラットフォーム（総称して「メッセージングサービス」）の利用を規定するものです。本ポリシーは、米国、欧州連合、英国、および日本における適用される電気通信、消費者保護、ならびにデータ保護法令を遵守し、メッセージ受信者を保護することを目的としています。  
  

1. 適用範囲および法的枠組み
本ポリシーは全世界に適用され、以下を含むがこれらに限定されない法令を遵守することを意図しています。
米国：電話消費者保護法（TCPA）、FCC規則、CTIAメッセージング原則
欧州連合：GDPR、ePrivacy指令
英国：UK GDPR、プライバシーおよび電子通信規則（PECR）
日本：個人情報の保護に関する法律（APPI）および電気通信関連法令
各国・地域の法令がより厳格な要件を定めている場合には、当該要件が優先されます。  
  

2. メッセージングの目的
Persefoniのメッセージングサービスは、顧客の事業に重大な影響を及ぼす可能性のあるサプライチェーン、サステナビリティ、規制、または市場動向に関する業務上および情報提供目的の通知（以下「アラート」）に限定されます。これらのメッセージは、販売促進またはマーケティング目的のものではありません。  
  

3. 同意およびオプトイン要件
Persefoniは、適用法域において事前の明示的な同意（またはこれと同等の合法的な同意）を提供した個人に対してのみメッセージを送信します。同意は以下の要件を満たす必要があります。
・自由意思に基づき、具体的で、十分な情報提供を受けた上で、明確に示されたものであること
・積極的な行為（未チェックのウェブサイトチェックボックス等）により提供されること
・初回メッセージ送信前に取得されること
・記録および監査が可能であること
【オプトイン時に表示される正確な同意文言】
「このチェックボックスを選択することにより、貴社に関連するサプライチェーンおよび事業アラートについて、Persefoniから自動送信されるテキストメッセージを受信することに同意します。メッセージの配信頻度はご契約のサブスクリプションプランにより異なり、1日あたり1通から最大24通までとなる場合があります。メッセージおよびデータ通信料が発生する場合があります。同意は購入条件ではありません。STOPと返信することで、いつでも配信を停止できます。」  
  

4. 記録管理および同意の証明
Persefoniは以下の記録を保持します。
・表示された同意文言
・同意取得日時
・同意取得方法および取得元
・加入者識別情報
これらの記録は、GDPRの説明責任原則およびTCPAのベストプラクティスを含む、適用法令に従って保存されます。  
  

5. メッセージ配信頻度およびプラン別配信
メッセージの配信頻度は顧客のサブスクリプションプランにより決定され、1日1通から最大24通までとなる場合があります。Persefoniは、アラートの最小または最大配信数を保証するものではなく、外部要因によるトリガー事象を管理することもありません。  
  

6. オプトアウトおよび同意の撤回
受信者は、STOP、CANCEL、END、またはUNSUBSCRIBEと返信することにより、いつでも同意を撤回できます。
・オプトアウト要求は即時または法令で定められた期間内に処理されます
・確認メッセージが1通送信される場合があります
・再度同意が取得されない限り、それ以降のメッセージは送信されません
EUおよび英国の受信者については、同意撤回は過去の適法な処理に影響を及ぼしません。  
  

7. プライバシーおよび国際データ移転
電話番号およびメッセージングに関するメタデータは個人データに該当します。Persefoniは、プライバシーポリシーおよび適用されるデータ保護法令に従ってこれらのデータを処理します。国際的にデータが移転される場合には、標準契約条項（SCC）を含む適切な保護措置が講じられます。  
  

8. 第三者メッセージングプロバイダー
Persefoniは第三者のメッセージングベンダーを利用する場合があります。これらのプロバイダーは処理者／サービス提供者として、本ポリシーおよび適用法令を遵守することが契約上義務付けられています。  
  

9. 執行およびコンプライアンス監督
Persefoniの法務部門は、メッセージングサービスに関する監督、執行、および規制当局対応を担当します。違反が認められた場合、メッセージング権限の停止または終了が行われることがあります。  
  

10. ポリシーの更新
本ポリシーは随時更新される場合があります。重要な変更については、Persefoniのウェブサイトまたは顧客向け通知を通じて周知されます。
【お問い合わせ先】
本ポリシーに関するご質問は、legal@persefoni.com までお問い合わせください。
